Mukand completed the sale of Kalwa and Dighe land parcels to AGP DC Infra for ₹111.85 Cr.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,269.09 Cr (+14.7% YoY), net profit ₹554.98 Cr (+4991.6% YoY).
